units.source_text: 这个雕有基督像的灯笼，可能是当年禁止基督教的时候制造的。

en.t: This lantern carved with an image of Christ was probably made at the time when Christianity was forbidden.

units.source_text: 由于石头的质量粗糙、不坚实，浮雕像又经过几百年风吹雨打，只有头部、身体和脚的形状依稀可辨。

en.t: Because the stone is coarse and not solid, and the relief has been weathered by wind and rain for several hundred years, only the shapes of the head, body, and feet can be faintly made out.

units.source_text: 可能原来就是一尊简单的雕像吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was originally just a simple statue.

units.source_text: 雕像的袖子很长，几乎拖到衣服的下摆，好像是合着掌，只有胳膊周围显得比较粗。

en.t: The statue's sleeves are very long, almost trailing down to the hem of the robe, and it seems to have its palms pressed together; only the area around the arms looks rather thick.
The figure is blurred and indistinct.

units.source_text: 然而，看上去与佛像或地藏菩萨像完全不同。

en.t: Yet at a glance it is entirely different from a Buddhist image or a statue of Jizo Bodhisattva.
